question: Should OpenClaw adopt fixed shared transcript limits for tool arguments and deeply nested tool results after the rebased implementation demonstrates the current redaction and transcript compatibility contract?
rationale: The proposed limits intentionally alter retained transcript content, and the blocked source review cannot establish whether the present contract already defines different boundaries or owners.

options.title: Require a rebased compatibility proof
options.body: Ask for a current-main rebase plus redacted live evidence that preserves redaction while bounding representative tool payloads.

options.title: Decline shared truncation semantics
options.body: Keep the existing sanitizer behavior if maintainers do not want fixed transcript truncation limits at this shared boundary.

recommendation.title: Require a rebased compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main rebase plus redacted live evidence that preserves redaction while bounding representative tool payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature history could not be inspected to identify a concrete transcript-sanitization owner.
